description: This file defines a configuration options class for an Azure Append Blob state machine storage provider within an Orleans project. It includes properties and methods for setting up Azure Blob Storage client options, container name, blob name generation, and lifecycle initialization stage.

classes.name: AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for Azure Append Blob State Machine Storage Provider in Orleans.
